summary: No blocking integrity defect found. All eight archived GT matrices were independently re-ranked and all authoritative inputs retained byte identity. The closed normal results are supported only with the stated single-seed, benchmark-selection, extra-budget and diagnostic limits; BC does not outperform matched AV or meet +1/+1.
independence_statement: Fresh delegated reviewer inspected source/results directly and wrote standalone standard-library checkers. Prior source-review hash lists were used as input metadata only; no prior PASS/WARN verdict served as numerical or semantic evidence. Actual host model/effort were not attested.

execution.weight_check: Actual archive SHA256 plus selected PI matrix raw-storage numerical check; no model load, forward/backward, unsafe pickle execution or original teacher weight attestation.
execution.checker_error_resolution: Own first raw checker incorrectly assumed full_metrics contained count/group fields; changed checker to use strict_reload for those fields, then completed a coherent rerun. Audited files were never changed.

A.name: Ground-truth provenance and train/benchmark separation
details: Every stored train/query/gallery label was independently reconstructed from its filename; all NPZ names, IDs, cameras and scenes matched the complete official-split manifests.

Observed counts are train8675/query1715/gallery8575, 50 train IDs and 50 disjoint benchmark IDs. Every train record appears in the 6563 saved batches per control; every actual batch is P8K8 and contains training names only.
Ranking removes only same-identity AND same-camera gallery records; positives are remaining dataset-identity matches. Gallery-index stable ties are retained. All queries have valid positives.

The actual saved hard-neighbor bank SHA matches both anchors, and its metadata/labels exactly match the official train manifest. Its source extracts train only; recorded Q/G forwards are zero. No benchmark labels supply this bank.

Training identity labels are relabeled to 0..49; benchmark labels remain the filename identities. The seven identity-reference gate inputs are stopped-gradient frozen model features, not performance GT.
A.limit: This local audit verifies archived filename/manifest/raw metadata and the producer code. Remote installed image files and original teacher weight bytes were not enumerated or replayed; recorded installed-tree checks are not new independent image attestations.

B.name: Score normalization and checkpoint selection
details: AP averages precision at relevant ranks, INP divides relevant count by last relevant rank, CMC averages valid-query hits, and percentages multiply by100. No reported metric denominator uses prediction max/min/mean.
L2 feature normalization, attention-query normalization and sigmoid gates are model operations; they do not rescale evaluation scores by their own maxima.

All 50 saved epochs were checked. Earliest maximum benchmark mAP selects frequency_shared E22 and axis_shared E26; all six metrics use that same selected checkpoint. Last-epoch values are retained separately.

The current runner directly calls full_records/evaluate. The legacy dev-selection main/docstring in full_evaluation.py does not describe this BC entry point; current run metadata explicitly discloses benchmark selection.
B.limit: PASS confirms truthful implementation/reporting of selection, not an untouched-test protocol; the limitation is included in E.

The two selected-normal distance payloads are exactly equal to recomputed state11. Paired base00 feature and distance payloads are exact; base00 per-query results match the original DeMo archived per-query CSV. This is not an independent baseline training run.

All8 individual child exit JSONs are present and exit0. Controller_result is COMPLETE. OS controller termination remains separately unattested.

D.name: Live producer and metric paths
details: The actual BC entry passes its builder/update and patched loader/optimizer into the complete official runner. Launcher invokes native, train, CPU normal audit and fixed-best state evaluation; eight exit records and outputs match that route.
full_metrics and distance are called by the active runner and state evaluator; their outputs appear in the actual best_per_query and state files and match independent raw recomputation.

The PI GELU forward hook multiplies the existing hidden64 by2sigmoid(Wb normalized detached frozen relation512). It is installed on both controls. Actual stored gate weights and nonzero saved gradient records corroborate a live trainable route, without asserting an independent neural replay.

The parent source imports were traced statically (94 local modules). Current hashes for322 sealed source artifacts match, and274 Python sources parse. This is not a claim of neural import or semantic execution of every module.
The old all49 audit mains and legacy dev-evaluation main are available source utilities, not executed BC conditions. Their existence does not count as additional BC evidence.

E.name: Exact scope, matching and claim ceiling
details: Scope is one RGBNT100 dataset, seed42, two matched controls, one normal modality condition and four frozen intervention states per selected checkpoint. Six metrics are not six missing-modality conditions. No new missing6/49 or multiseed/generalization result is supplied.

Both BC arms reuse the same original DeMo50 seed42 E8 identity teacher, then train fresh expert/heads for an additional50 with a new Adam schedule. Original DeMo received50 epochs; each BC/AV control has a teacher50+expert50 lineage. The two BC arms have matched extra compute/architecture counts; equal wall time is not asserted.

BC adds32768 trainable parameters in both arms relative to AV:total99617926/trainable1920134, descriptor5120. The ordinary mixed-source control receives the same gate/capacity. Exact current paired record/partial-set schedule and exact AV schedule were verified.

Full benchmark mAP selects checkpoints and historical benchmark results informed recipe choice. These scores cannot establish unbiased held-out generalization or statistical significance. Query records and state interventions are not independent replicates.
State00 is the frozen original teacher path inside the same selected model. States10/01/11 are fixed-weight interventions, not separately retrained ablations or independent baseline models.

The gate gradient is the saved post-unscale accumulated parent-objective gradient after the parent update; it is not an isolated retrieval-only gradient. Nonzero gradients/changing weights/norm continuity do not prove useful modulation, causal rescue, calibrated gates, spatial evidence or improved retrieval.

Axis BC improves original DeMo by0.2449184184 mAP points and0.0583090379 Rank1 points, below the +1/+1 goal. It is lower than matched AV axis by0.1411577801 mAP and0.1166180758 Rank1. Ordinary BC is also below matched AV ordinary. No promotion or successful-method claim is supported.

F.name: Real GT versus model-derived diagnostics
details: Retrieval correctness uses dataset filename IDs and camera exclusion, never model-generated reference labels.

Training contribution targets are detached model-state margin differences with train-label-based positive/negative mining. The code explicitly limits them as empirical proxies, not dataset AP or causal effects.
The train centroid graph is derived from frozen model features over training data, and the identity reference gate reads frozen feature coordinates. Neither is substituted for retrieval GT.
Gradient and norm analysis remains descriptive, with no neural replay or evidence of per-query gate calibration/saturation.

nonblocking_findings.message: One dataset/seed and benchmark-driven checkpoint/recipe selection; no untouched-test or statistical-generalization claim.
BC is below matched AV in both arms; +1/+1 versus original is unmet. Frozen00 and frozen10/01 do not establish independently retrained ablations.
Saved nonzero objective gradients/weight changes and contribution margins are not proof of calibrated identity utility or causal retrieval improvement.
Host model/effort, original image tree/teacher bytes, neural replay and OS controller exit were not independently attested in this local-only review.
